Signs

Read the signs you see around you.

For teachers and tutors

About Signs

Common public and safety signs shown as pictures, without words: no smoking, no parking, do not enter, wet floor, danger, first aid, exit, toilets, wheelchair access, no food or drink, and bus stop. The learner taps what the sign means.

How to play

  1. Look at the sign.
  2. Read the four meanings.
  3. Tap the right one.

Play it as a class

Choose Signs in the Teacher Game, then walk around the building and find the same signs.
